#
# Hashed pins for the CI-only tools in requirements-ci.in: pytest-cov (the
# coverage leg), pytest-playwright and playwright (browser engines), build
# (build-dist) and pip-audit. ci.yml used to install these by exact version
# but without hashes, so the bytes were whatever the index served that day.
# Install with pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-ci-lock.txt.
#
# Resolved for the jobs that install it -- ubuntu-latest, CPython 3.12, x86_64
# -- with requirements-lock.txt as constraints, so every package the two files
# share is pinned identically (tests/test_packaging.py checks that) and both
# install into one environment. pip itself is left out: pip-audit depends on
# it, and the runner's own pip satisfies that without a download.
#
# Compiled with uv 0.10.9, from the repository root, by:
#
#    uv pip compile requirements-ci.in -c requirements-lock.txt --generate-hashes \
#        --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 \
#        --no-emit-package pip --no-header -o requirements-ci-lock.txt
#
# and this header restored above the output. Not resolved for Windows or
# macOS: nothing installs it there.
#
